verdict.rationale: CoreWeave is a GPU cloud platform, so user-defined background automations are a fair axis. The evidence shows only adjacent features: Cluster Autoscaler node scaling, bucket lifecycle expiration rules, Slurm batch jobs via SUNK, and an interactive Mission Control Agent. None of these is a documented capability for users to set up autonomous or recurring automations, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
